proposal.name: Give large model checks room to finish

plan.name: Give large model checks room to finish
plan.summary: When a budgeted TLC check reports Java heap or GC exhaustion, retry it once with all of the known Docker memory left after the existing quarter reserve, rounded down to MiB, if that exceeds its normal slot: finish cleanup, release its ordinary slot, drain other TLC containers, and admit the retry exclusively without starvation or deadlock. Keep equal container memory and memory-plus-swap limits and a three-quarter heap, preserve cancellation and the original execution allowance through the wait and retry, retain the separate one-stall-retry limit without resetting it on escalation, and leave unknown-capacity, no-headroom, standalone and exit-137-only failures unexpanded. Record every budgeted check attempt with its check identity, module, ordinal, allocated container and heap bytes, outcome and diagnostic in gate JSON, and show allocations and retry outcomes in feedback and Markdown receipts for full, model-only and existing-Python gates; this intentionally changes the no-memory-retry and whole-receipt equality expectations in internal/verify/tlc_resources_accept_test.go while preserving model evidence, final verdicts and fingerprints independently of resource history. Give each modeled synthesis agent run's gate tool its remaining execution allowance through Job.ToolTimeout, including fallback runs and the existing longest-safe-timer convention for uncut runs, preserving backend rounding, timer limits, larger explicit timeouts, account-wait accounting and ordinary non-gate job defaults. Update SPEC.md, docs/gate.md and docs/factory.md to describe the retry, reporting and modeled gate timeout rules, citing the existing foundations D-0315, D-0306 and D-0173; the merger must record the new decision extending those policies, since this plumbing build cannot write decisions/.

tests.name: TestTLC540ExclusiveMemoryRetry
tests.says: Two checks that exhaust their normal heaps release their slots and each retry once with the full reserved budget, after other containers finish; larger retries run alone, waiting ordinary work eventually finishes, and retries keep the original configuration.

tests.name: TestTLC540RetryCancellation
tests.says: Cancellation and CheckWithin's original deadline cut off a memory retry waiting for exclusive admission, wrap the context cause, start no larger container, and leave capacity usable by other checks.

tests.name: TestTLC540RetryBoundedAndClassified
tests.says: Confirmed heap and GC diagnostics and TLC's three memory frames permit one larger attempt; repeated exhaustion remains an operational failure without partial model evidence, while exit 137 alone, ordinary failures, unknown capacity, no headroom and standalone runners cannot earn an expansion.

tests.name: TestTLC540GateRecordsMemoryAttempts
tests.says: Full and model-only gates recover design, witness and conformance checks that need more memory, record both attempts under one check identity in the tlc_attempts JSON array (check, module, attempt, memory_bytes, heap_bytes, outcome, message), distinguish conformance batches, and show their allocations and outcomes to people and the gate caller without changing the successful evidence fingerprint.

tests.name: TestModeledGate540UsesBuildAllowance
tests.says: Synthesize supplies its gate job with the run's allowance, refreshes it for fallback using the shared execution time remaining when present, and uses a negative ToolTimeout for an uncut build; real backend launch paths deliver the corresponding Codex configuration or Claude Code timeout and idle settings to fake CLIs.

usage.summary: Wrote `plan.json` and five acceptance tests covering exclusive TLC memory retries, attempt reporting, and modeled gate timeouts. The check passed: all five tests fail on the base code as required, and `repo/` is unchanged.
